dispute_ticket.description: I cancelled my 6pm advance booking before the driver reached me and was charged $5.00. The driver was still very far away and my flight was changed so I had no choice. I was very upset about the charge. Please refund it.

chat_logs.content: Hi, I will be at Bishan MRT by 6pm.

app_events.details: Rider R-7109 booked ADVANCED trip RYDE-DS-009 from Bishan MRT to Changi Airport T3 for 2026-10-08 18:00.
Driver D-8109 accepted the advance booking. Match time 17:20:00.
Rider cancelled 8 min 50 s before the scheduled time, inside the 15-minute advance window. Cancellation fee S$5.00 applied.
Cancellation confirmation screen showed an error banner; the cancellation itself was recorded correctly.

advanced_trip_free_cancellation_min_befo.text: For an advance booking, the number of minutes before the scheduled pickup time up to which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations of advance bookings only.

cancellation_fee_after_driver_assigned.text: The cancellation fee in SGD for a rider who cancels after the free window of an advance booking has closed. It governs rider cancellations only.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: This was an advance booking for 18:00 and the rider cancelled at 17:51:10, 8 min 50 s before the scheduled time. This trip's policy makes cancellation free only until 15 minutes before the scheduled time (17:45), so the window had closed and the S$5.00 fee applies. The driver being about 7 km away on GPS, the flight change and the error banner on the confirmation screen do not alter the window.
